ننتدي (form VII)
# نَنْتَدِي (nantadī) /nan.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَى (intadā)
# نَنْتَدِيَ (nantadiya) /nan.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَدَى (intadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
